Our sarcasm research was featured in IBM Think, in a piece on why AI still struggles to catch sarcasm — and why that's a problem for AI in customer-facing roles.

The piece draws on our work with Xiyuan Gao, now a newly minted PhD graduate, and Shekhar Nayak: our survey of the field, and the augmented multimodal datasets we've built for sarcasm detection.

Read it here: [AI understands you? Yeah, right](https://www.ibm.com/think/news/ai-understands-you-yeah-right)
